blurb.en: Every pygame program has the same bones: start pygame, open a window, then loop - handle events, update, draw, flip - until the window is closed.
blurb.zh: 每个 pygame 程序都是同一副骨架：启动 pygame、开窗口，然后一圈圈循环——处理事件、更新、绘制、翻屏——直到窗口被关掉。

en: What you see: a window 480 pixels wide and 320 high with Game loop in its title bar and a dark navy background. A yellow dot of radius 12 slides from left to right along the middle, 2 pixels every frame, and when it reaches the right edge it starts again from the left. The program keeps going until you click the window's close button.

pygame.init() starts pygame's parts, set_mode opens the window and hands back a surface to draw on (screen), and Clock keeps time. After that everything happens inside while running:, and each pass round the loop is one frame. A frame has three stages in a fixed order. First handle events: pygame.event.get() hands over everything that has happened since the last frame - key presses, mouse clicks, the close button - and empties the queue. Then update: change the numbers that describe the game (here just frame). Then draw: paint the whole picture again from scratch and finally flip.

Drawing happens on a hidden copy of the screen. fill wipes it with the background colour, circle paints the dot, and pygame.display.flip() swaps the finished picture onto the window in one go, so you never see a half-drawn frame. clock.tick(FPS) waits just long enough that the loop runs at most 60 times a second; without it the dot would race across as fast as the computer can go.

Closing the window does not stop the program by itself: it only puts a QUIT event in the queue. The loop notices it, sets running to False, the while ends, and the last line of main shuts pygame down again - the partner of the pygame.init() at the start.

Why the split into functions? dot_position is plain logic - given a frame number it works out where the dot is, with no window involved, so it can be read and tested on its own. main holds everything that needs a screen. And the main loop only starts under if __name__ == "__main__":, so importing this file (to test dot_position, say) defines the functions without opening a window. At 60 frames a second the dot crosses the 480 pixels in 240 frames, which is 4 seconds.
To run it: pip install pygame, then run the file - a window opens instead of any printed output.
zh: 看到的样子：一个宽 480、高 320 像素的窗口，标题栏写着 Game loop，背景是深蓝色。一个半径 12 的黄点沿窗口中线从左往右滑，每帧 2 像素，到了右边缘就从左边重新开始。程序一直跑，直到你点窗口的关闭按钮。

pygame.init() 启动 pygame 的各个部件，set_mode 打开窗口并交回一块可以画画的表面（screen），Clock 负责计时。之后的一切都发生在 while running: 里，循环每转一圈就是一帧。一帧按固定顺序分三段。先处理事件：pygame.event.get() 把上一帧以来发生的一切——按键、鼠标点击、关闭按钮——都交出来，并清空队列。再更新：改那些描述游戏状态的数（这里只有 frame）。最后绘制：把整幅画面从头重画一遍，然后翻屏。
画是画在屏幕的一份隐藏副本上的。fill 用背景色把它刷干净，circle 画上那个点，pygame.display.flip() 再把画好的整幅画面一次换到窗口上，所以你永远看不到画了一半的帧。clock.tick(FPS) 会等上恰好够长的时间，让循环每秒最多转 60 圈；没有它，那个点会以电脑能跑出的最快速度冲过去。
关窗口本身并不会让程序停下：它只是往队列里放一个 QUIT 事件。循环看到它，把 running 设成 False，while 结束，main 的最后一行再把 pygame 关掉——它和开头的 pygame.init() 是一对。
为什么要拆成函数？dot_position 是纯逻辑——给它帧号，它算出点在哪里，跟窗口毫无关系，所以可以单独读、单独测。main 装着一切需要屏幕的东西。主循环只在 if __name__ == "__main__": 下面才启动，所以 import 这个文件（比如为了测 dot_position）只会定义函数、不会开窗口。每秒 60 帧时，点走完 480 像素要 240 帧，也就是 4 秒。
运行方法：先 pip install pygame，再运行这个文件——它不打印任何东西，而是弹出一个窗口。

lineNotes.en: Starts all of pygame's parts; it must come before any window or font is made.
lineNotes.zh: 启动 pygame 的全部部件；开窗口、建字体之前必须先调用它。

lineNotes.en: Everything that happened since the last frame, handed over and removed from the queue.
lineNotes.zh: 上一帧以来发生的所有事件，一次交出来，并从队列里拿掉。

lineNotes.en: Shows the finished frame: the hidden picture is swapped onto the window in one go.
lineNotes.zh: 把画好的这一帧显示出来：隐藏的画面一次换到窗口上。

lineNotes.en: Waits so that the loop runs at most FPS times a second.
lineNotes.zh: 等一会儿，让循环每秒最多转 FPS 圈。

title.en: Move a Fixed Number of Pixels per Frame

blurb.en: The simplest way to animate: add 3 to x every frame. It works - until the frame rate changes, and then the speed changes with it.
blurb.zh: 最简单的动画：每帧给 x 加 3。它能动——直到帧率一变，速度也跟着变。

en: What you see: a window 480 by 200 with a light blue square, 30 pixels on each side, sliding from left to right across the middle. When it goes past the right edge it reappears just off the left edge and slides in again, for ever, until you close the window.

Each frame main moves x on by STEP = 3 pixels through step_x, then passes it through wrap, which sends x back to -30 (one square width to the left of the window, so the square slides in rather than popping up) once x is past WIDTH.

The speed is written in pixels per frame, so how fast the square moves depends on how many frames there are in a second. At 60 frames a second it moves 3 x 60 = 180 pixels a second and crosses the window in under 3 seconds. Change FPS to 30 and it moves only 90 pixels a second and takes twice as long. On a slow computer that cannot reach 60 frames, the whole game runs in slow motion.

position_after shows the same thing without a window: it counts frames, not time. position_after(60, 3) is 180 and position_after(30, 3) is 90 - one second at 60 frames and one second at 30 frames end in different places.
The fix is to write the speed in pixels per second and multiply by the time each frame took: compare Move at a Speed with dt, whose loop is the same apart from a few lines.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×200 的窗口里，一个边长 30 像素的浅蓝方块沿中线从左往右滑。越过右边缘之后，它会在左边缘外面重新出现、再滑进来，一直这样，直到你关窗口。
每一帧 main 先借 step_x 让 x 前进 STEP = 3 像素，再交给 wrap：x 一旦超过 WIDTH，就把它送回 -30（窗口左边再往左一个方块宽，这样方块是滑进来的，而不是突然冒出来）。
速度写的是「像素 / 帧」，所以方块跑多快取决于一秒里有多少帧。每秒 60 帧时，它每秒走 3 × 60 = 180 像素，不到 3 秒就穿过窗口。把 FPS 改成 30，它每秒只走 90 像素，要花两倍的时间。电脑慢、跑不到 60 帧时，整个游戏都变成慢动作。
position_after 不开窗口也说明了同一件事：它数的是帧，不是时间。position_after(60, 3) 是 180，position_after(30, 3) 是 90——60 帧下的一秒和 30 帧下的一秒，停在不同的地方。
解决办法是把速度写成「像素 / 秒」，再乘上每一帧实际用掉的时间：对照「运动：速度乘 dt」，它的循环只有几行不同。

lineNotes.en: The speed, in pixels per frame - the unit is the whole problem.
lineNotes.zh: 速度，单位是「像素 / 帧」——问题就出在这个单位上。

lineNotes.en: One square width off the left edge, so the square slides back in.
lineNotes.zh: 放到左边缘外一个方块宽的地方，让方块重新滑进来。

title.en: Move at a Speed with dt

blurb.en: Give the speed in pixels per second and multiply by dt, the seconds the last frame took: the square now moves at the same speed at any frame rate.
blurb.zh: 速度用「像素 / 秒」给出，再乘上 dt（上一帧用掉的秒数）：方块在任何帧率下都以同样的速度移动。

en: What you see: the same window and the same wrapping square as in Move a Fixed Number of Pixels per Frame, this time green - and it crosses the window at 180 pixels a second whatever the frame rate is.

clock.tick(FPS) does two jobs. It waits to keep the loop at no more than FPS frames a second, and it returns how many milliseconds have passed since the previous tick - usually 16 or 17 at 60 frames a second. Dividing by 1000 turns that into seconds, dt. The move for this frame is then speed times dt: at 60 frames a second each frame is about 3 pixels, at 30 frames about 6 pixels, and either way the square covers 180 pixels a second.

position_after replays a list of frame times in milliseconds. position_after([16, 17, 17], 180) is 9.0: the three frames add up to 50 milliseconds, and a twentieth of a second at 180 pixels a second is 9 pixels. Any list of frames that adds up to the same time ends at the same place, however it is split into frames - which is exactly what frame-rate independence means.

x is kept as a float and only rounded when the square is drawn. A pygame Rect stores whole numbers and cuts the fractional part off (Rect(1.7, 0, 2, 2) sits at x = 1), so keeping the position in a Rect would lose the fraction every frame - at small speeds the square would never move at all. The round(x, 9) at the end of position_after only tidies away floating-point dust in the last digits.
zh: 看到的样子：和「运动：每帧挪固定像素」一样的窗口、一样会从右边绕回左边的方块，这次是绿色的——不管帧率是多少，它都以每秒 180 像素的速度穿过窗口。
clock.tick(FPS) 干两件事。它会等一等，让循环每秒不超过 FPS 帧；它还交回上一次 tick 到现在过了多少毫秒——每秒 60 帧时通常是 16 或 17。除以 1000 就变成秒，也就是 dt。这一帧该走的距离就是速度乘 dt：每秒 60 帧时每帧约 3 像素，30 帧时约 6 像素，两种情况下方块每秒都走 180 像素。
position_after 把一串以毫秒计的帧时长重放一遍。position_after([16, 17, 17], 180) 是 9.0：三帧加起来 50 毫秒，每秒 180 像素走二十分之一秒就是 9 像素。只要一串帧的总时长相同，不管怎么切成一帧一帧，最后都停在同一个地方——这正是「与帧率无关」的意思。
x 存成浮点数，只在画方块时才取整。pygame 的 Rect 只存整数，会把小数部分直接截掉（Rect(1.7, 0, 2, 2) 的 x 是 1），所以位置若存在 Rect 里，每一帧都会丢掉小数——速度小时方块根本动不起来。position_after 末尾的 round(x, 9) 只是抹掉最后几位的浮点误差。

lineNotes.en: The speed is now in pixels per second, not pixels per frame.
lineNotes.zh: 速度的单位现在是「像素 / 秒」，不再是「像素 / 帧」。

lineNotes.en: Only tidies away floating-point dust in the last digits of the float.
lineNotes.zh: 只是抹掉浮点数最后几位的误差。

lineNotes.at: pygame.draw.rect(screen, SQUARE_COLOUR, (round(x), HEIGHT // 2 - SIZE // 2, SIZE, SIZE))
lineNotes.en: Round only at the moment of drawing; the true position stays a float.
lineNotes.zh: 只在画的那一刻取整；真正的位置仍然是浮点数。

blurb.en: rect, circle, line and polygon, filled or as outlines - and pygame's coordinates, where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and y grows downwards.
blurb.zh: rect、circle、line、polygon，实心的或只画边框——以及 pygame 的坐标系：(0, 0) 在左上角，y 往下增大。

en: What you see: a dark window 480 by 320 with a grid of 6 columns and 4 rows of 60-pixel squares, 12 pixels apart and 12 pixels in from the top-left corner. The 1st, 3rd and 5th columns are solid blue squares; the 2nd, 4th and 6th are white outlines 3 pixels wide. An orange circle sits in the middle of the top-left square, a thin orange line runs from the window's top-left corner to its bottom-right corner, and an orange triangle sits near the top-right corner, partly covering the last square of the first row.

pygame's coordinates start at the top-left corner of the window, and y grows downwards - the opposite of a maths graph. So row 0 is at the top, each later row is lower down, and the line from (0, 0) to (480, 320) slopes down to the right.

grid_rects works out every square: its top-left corner starts one gap in from the window's corner, and each column further right (or row further down) adds one square plus one gap. grid_rects(6, 4, 60, 12) starts (12, 12, 60, 60), (84, 12, 60, 60), and ends with (372, 228, 60, 60). Each rectangle is built as a pygame.Rect and handed back as a plain tuple (x, y, width, height); main turns each tuple back into a Rect with pygame.Rect(cell).

The drawing functions all take the surface and a colour first. pygame.draw.rect fills the rectangle, unless a fourth argument gives a border width - then only an outline that wide is drawn. circle takes a centre and a radius, line two end points and a width, polygon a list of corner points. Things are painted in the order the code runs, so later shapes cover earlier ones - that is why the line and the triangle lie on top of the squares.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×320 的深色窗口，里面是 6 列 4 行、边长 60 像素的方块，彼此相隔 12 像素，离左上角也是 12 像素。第 1、3、5 列是实心的蓝方块，第 2、4、6 列是 3 像素宽的白色边框。左上角那一格正中有一个橙色圆，一条细橙线从窗口左上角连到右下角，右上角附近还有一个橙色三角形，盖住了第一行最后一个方块的一部分。
pygame 的坐标从窗口左上角开始，y 往下增大——和数学里的坐标图正好相反。所以第 0 行在最上面，后面每一行都更靠下；从 (0, 0) 到 (480, 320) 的那条线是往右下斜的。

grid_rects 算出每一个方块：左上角先离窗口的角一个 gap，之后每往右一列（或往下一行），就再加一个方块宽和一个间隙。grid_rects(6, 4, 60, 12) 以 (12, 12, 60, 60)、(84, 12, 60, 60) 开头，以 (372, 228, 60, 60) 结尾。每个矩形先建成 pygame.Rect，再以普通元组 (x, y, 宽, 高) 交回；main 用 pygame.Rect(cell) 把元组变回 Rect。
这些绘图函数的前两个实参都是表面和颜色。pygame.draw.rect 画实心矩形，除非第四个实参给出边框宽度——那时只画这么宽的边框。circle 收圆心和半径，line 收两个端点和线宽，polygon 收一串顶点。东西按代码执行的顺序画上去，后画的盖住先画的——所以那条线和三角形压在方块上面。

lineNotes.en: Rects become plain (x, y, width, height) tuples before they leave the function.
lineNotes.zh: 矩形在离开函数前变成普通的 (x, y, 宽, 高) 元组。

lineNotes.en: A filled shape through the listed corners; drawn last, so it covers what is under it.
lineNotes.zh: 按列出的顶点画实心多边形；它最后画，所以盖住下面的东西。

blurb.en: Colours as (red, green, blue) tuples and as pygame.Color, and Color.lerp to mix two of them in any proportion - one vertical line per pixel makes a smooth gradient.
blurb.zh: 颜色可以是 (红, 绿, 蓝) 元组，也可以是 pygame.Color；Color.lerp 按任意比例把两种颜色混起来——每个像素一条竖线，就是一条平滑的渐变带。

en: What you see: a window 480 by 240 with a very dark background and, across its middle from y = 40 to y = 200, a band that fades smoothly from orange-red on the left to bright blue on the right, passing through purple half way.

A colour is three numbers from 0 to 255: how much red, green and blue light. LEFT is (255, 90, 60), RIGHT is (40, 120, 255). pygame accepts plain tuples like these almost everywhere, and also has its own pygame.Color type, which carries a fourth number, alpha (transparency, 255 = solid). screen.fill paints the whole surface one colour.

blend turns c1 into a Color and asks it for lerp (linear interpolation) towards c2: t = 0 gives c1, t = 1 gives c2, and t = 0.5 is half way. Each channel is worked out as c1 * (1 - t) + c2 * t and rounded, with an exact half going up - blend(LEFT, RIGHT, 0.5) is (148, 105, 158), because the red channel 147.5 goes up to 148. The result is a Color with four parts, so blend makes it a tuple and keeps the first three.

In main, x runs over every column from 0 to 479, and t is worked out from x so that it runs from 0 at the first column to exactly 1 at the last. That matters: lerp only accepts t from 0 to 1 and raises ValueError for anything outside, so dividing by WIDTH would never quite reach the right-hand colour and dividing by something smaller would crash on the last columns. Each column gets a one-pixel vertical line in its own colour, and 480 slightly different lines side by side look like a smooth gradient.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×240、背景很暗的窗口，中间从 y = 40 到 y = 200 横着一条色带，从左边的橙红平滑地过渡到右边的亮蓝，正中间是紫色。
一种颜色是三个 0 到 255 的数：红、绿、蓝三种光各有多少。LEFT 是 (255, 90, 60)，RIGHT 是 (40, 120, 255)。pygame 几乎处处都收这样的普通元组，它也有自己的 pygame.Color 类型，多带第四个数 alpha（透明度，255 表示完全不透明）。screen.fill 把整个表面刷成一种颜色。

blend 把 c1 变成 Color，再让它朝 c2 做 lerp（线性插值）：t = 0 得到 c1，t = 1 得到 c2，t = 0.5 是正中间。每个分量按 c1 * (1 - t) + c2 * t 算出来再四舍五入，恰好一半时往上取——blend(LEFT, RIGHT, 0.5) 是 (148, 105, 158)，因为红色分量 147.5 往上取成 148。结果是有四个分量的 Color，所以 blend 把它变成元组、只留前三个。
main 里 x 走遍从 0 到 479 的每一列，t 由 x 算出，从第一列的 0 走到最后一列的恰好 1。这一点很要紧：lerp 只收 0 到 1 之间的 t，超出就抛 ValueError；除以 WIDTH 永远到不了右端的颜色，除以更小的数则会在最后几列崩掉。每一列画一条 1 像素宽、自己颜色的竖线，480 条颜色略有不同的线并排起来，看上去就是一条平滑的渐变。

lineNotes.en: A plain (r, g, b) tuple becomes a pygame Color, which has the lerp method.
lineNotes.zh: 普通的 (r, g, b) 元组变成 pygame 的 Color，Color 才有 lerp 方法。

lineNotes.en: One vertical line, one pixel wide, per column of the window.
lineNotes.zh: 窗口每一列画一条 1 像素宽的竖线。

title.zh: 方向键移动，关在窗口里

blurb.en: Two ways to read the keyboard: a KEYDOWN event arrives once per press, key.get_pressed() says what is held down right now. Rect.clamp keeps the square inside the window.
blurb.zh: 读键盘的两种办法：KEYDOWN 事件每按一下来一次，key.get_pressed() 说的是此刻哪些键按着。Rect.clamp 把方块关在窗口里。

en: What you see: a window 480 by 320 with a yellow square, 40 pixels on each side, starting in the middle. Hold an arrow key and it glides that way at 240 pixels a second; let go and it stops at once. Hold two keys, say right and up, and it moves diagonally; hold left and right together and they cancel. At the edges it stops dead instead of leaving the window. Each press of the space bar swaps its colour between yellow and green.

The two ways of reading keys do different jobs. A KEYDOWN event arrives once when a key goes down - holding the space bar does not keep swapping the colour - so events suit single actions: jump, fire, pause, change colour. pygame.key.get_pressed() instead gives, every frame, whether each key is being held at that moment, which suits continuous movement. main turns the arrow keys that are held into a set of direction names such as {"left", "up"}, using the ARROWS dictionary to look up each key's code.

step moves the square by pixels in each direction that is held. step((0, 100), {"left"}, 4) is (0, 100): the square is already at the left edge, so it cannot go further. step((438, 0), {"right", "up"}, 4) is (440, 0): the right edge stops it at 480 - 40 = 440 and the top edge keeps y at 0.

Rect.clamp returns a new rectangle moved just far enough to lie inside another one - here SCREEN, the whole window - and leaves the original alone, so its result has to be stored (clamp_ip is the version that changes the rectangle in place). A Rect only holds whole numbers and cuts any fraction off, so main rounds SPEED * dt to whole pixels before handing it to step: at 60 frames a second that is 4 pixels a frame.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×320 的窗口，一个边长 40 像素的黄方块从正中间开始。按住方向键，它就以每秒 240 像素朝那边滑；一松手立刻停下。同时按住两个键，比如右和上，它斜着走；左右一起按则互相抵消。到了边上它会停住，而不是跑出窗口。每按一下空格，它的颜色就在黄和绿之间换一次。
两种读键盘的办法各有各的用处。KEYDOWN 事件只在键按下去的那一刻来一次——按住空格不放，颜色也不会一直换——所以事件适合一次性的动作：跳、开火、暂停、换颜色。pygame.key.get_pressed() 则每一帧都告诉你每个键此刻是不是按着，适合持续的移动。main 借 ARROWS 字典查出每个方向键的键码，把按着的方向键变成一个方向名集合，比如 {"left", "up"}。
step 朝每个按着的方向把方块挪 pixels 像素。step((0, 100), {"left"}, 4) 是 (0, 100)：方块已经贴着左边，再也走不过去。step((438, 0), {"right", "up"}, 4) 是 (440, 0)：右边把它挡在 480 - 40 = 440，上边让 y 停在 0。
Rect.clamp 交回一个新矩形，它刚好挪到另一个矩形——这里是整个窗口 SCREEN——里面，原来的矩形不变，所以要把结果存下来（clamp_ip 才是就地修改的那个版本）。Rect 只存整数，会把小数截掉，所以 main 先把 SPEED * dt 取整成整像素，再交给 step：每秒 60 帧时就是每帧 4 像素。

lineNotes.en: The whole window as a rectangle - the area the square is clamped into.
lineNotes.zh: 把整个窗口当成一个矩形——方块被夹在它里面。

lineNotes.at: keys = {name for name, code in ARROWS.items() if pressed[code]}
lineNotes.en: The names of the arrow keys held down at this moment, as a set.
lineNotes.zh: 此刻按着的方向键的名字，组成一个集合。

blurb.en: A MOUSEBUTTONDOWN event carries where the click was; Rect.collidepoint says which button it landed in - counting the left and top edges but not the right and bottom ones.
blurb.zh: MOUSEBUTTONDOWN 事件带着点击的位置；Rect.collidepoint 判断它落在哪个按钮里——左边、上边算在里面，右边、下边不算。

en: What you see: a dark window 480 by 320 with three buttons along the bottom - red, green and blue, each 120 by 50 pixels with a thin white outline. Left-click a button and a big circle of radius 70 in its colour appears in the upper middle of the window, and that button's outline becomes thicker. Clicking anywhere else, or with another mouse button, changes nothing.

When a mouse button goes down pygame sends a MOUSEBUTTONDOWN event. event.pos is where the pointer was, as (x, y), and event.button says which button it was: 1 is the left button and 3 the right one. The elif makes sure a single event is only checked against one kind at a time.

clicked turns each button's (x, y, width, height) tuple into a Rect and asks collidepoint whether pos is inside, and returns the index of the first button that says yes, or -1 if none does. Earlier buttons in the list win if two overlap.

collidepoint counts a rectangle's left and top edges as inside but its right and bottom edges as outside: Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) contains (3, 3) and (0, 0) but not (4, 4) or (4, 0), and a rectangle with zero width or height contains no point at all. The red button (40, 240, 120, 50) covers x from 40 to 159, so clicked(BUTTONS, (160, 250)) is -1 - that pixel belongs to the gap - while clicked(BUTTONS, (180, 250)) is 1, the green button. Because the right edge is not included, two buttons placed side by side with no gap never both claim the same pixel.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×320 的深色窗口，底部一排三个按钮——红、绿、蓝，每个 120×50 像素，带细白边框。用左键点一个按钮，窗口上半部正中就出现一个半径 70、那个颜色的大圆，那个按钮的边框也变粗。点别处，或用别的鼠标键点，什么都不变。
鼠标键按下时，pygame 发一个 MOUSEBUTTONDOWN 事件。event.pos 是指针所在的位置 (x, y)，event.button 说是哪个键：1 是左键，3 是右键。elif 保证一个事件一次只对照一种类型。
clicked 把每个按钮的 (x, y, 宽, 高) 元组变成 Rect，问 collidepoint 那个点在不在里面，交回第一个说「在」的按钮的下标，一个都没有就交回 -1。两个按钮重叠时，列表里靠前的赢。

collidepoint 把矩形的左边、上边算在里面，右边、下边算在外面：Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) 包含 (3, 3) 和 (0, 0)，不包含 (4, 4) 和 (4, 0)；宽或高为 0 的矩形不包含任何点。红按钮 (40, 240, 120, 50) 覆盖的 x 是 40 到 159，所以 clicked(BUTTONS, (160, 250)) 是 -1——那个像素属于按钮之间的空隙——而 clicked(BUTTONS, (180, 250)) 是 1，绿按钮。正因为右边不算在内，两个紧挨着、中间没有空隙的按钮，永远不会同时认领同一个像素。

lineNotes.en: No button contained the point.
lineNotes.zh: 没有哪个按钮包含这个点。

lineNotes.en: event.pos is where the pointer was when the button went down.
lineNotes.zh: event.pos 是鼠标键按下那一刻指针的位置。

blurb.en: Text in pygame is a picture: a Font renders it into a surface, get_rect(center=...) positions that surface, and blit copies it onto the screen.
blurb.zh: pygame 里的文字是一张图：Font 把它渲染成一块表面，get_rect(center=...) 给这块表面定位，blit 再把它复制到屏幕上。

en: What you see: a dark window 480 by 320 with Hello, pygame! in large cream letters exactly in the middle, and below it, near the bottom, a small grey counter reading frame 1, frame 2, frame 3 and so on, counting up 30 times a second and staying centred as the number gets longer.

A pygame.font.Font made with None where a font file name would go loads pygame's own built-in font - no font file is needed, so the program runs on any computer. render(text, True, colour) draws the words into a new surface (True turns on smooth edges), and screen.blit(surface, place) copies that surface onto the screen with its top-left corner at place.

To centre something you need its size. centre_topleft makes a Rect the size of the screen and one the size of the text, sets the text's center to the screen's center, and reads back the top-left corner. Setting center puts the top-left at the centre minus half the size, rounded down: a 5 by 3 rectangle centred on (10, 10) has its top-left at (8, 9). With pygame 2.6.1's built-in font the title is 319 by 47 pixels, so it is drawn with its top-left at (81, 137).

The counter does the same in one step: counter.get_rect(center=...) returns the surface's rectangle already moved so that its center is at the given point. Any Rect position can be given this way - topleft=, midbottom=, right= and so on. Because the counter's text changes every frame it is rendered and positioned again every frame, which is what keeps it centred.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×320 的深色窗口，正中间是奶油色的大字 Hello, pygame!，下方靠近底边有一个灰色小计数器，写着 frame 1、frame 2、frame 3……每秒往上数 30 次，数字变长了也始终居中。
pygame.font.Font 在该写字体文件名的地方写 None，加载的就是 pygame 自带的内置字体——不需要任何字体文件，所以程序在哪台电脑上都能跑。render(文字, True, 颜色) 把文字画进一块新的表面（True 打开边缘平滑），screen.blit(表面, 位置) 再把这块表面复制到屏幕上，左上角对准那个位置。

要居中，先得知道大小。centre_topleft 建一个屏幕大小的 Rect、一个文字大小的 Rect，把文字的 center 设成屏幕的 center，再读回左上角。设置 center 会让左上角等于中心减去一半的大小、向下取整：5×3 的矩形以 (10, 10) 为中心，左上角是 (8, 9)。用 pygame 2.6.1 的内置字体，标题是 319×47 像素，所以它的左上角画在 (81, 137)。
计数器一步做完同样的事：counter.get_rect(center=...) 交回的矩形已经挪好，中心就在给定的点上。Rect 的任何位置属性都可以这样给——topleft=、midbottom=、right= 等等。计数器的文字每帧都在变，所以每帧都重新渲染、重新定位，这正是它始终居中的原因。

lineNotes.en: The top-left corner is what blit needs.
lineNotes.zh: blit 要的就是左上角。

lineNotes.en: A fresh picture of the text every frame, because the number changes.
lineNotes.zh: 每帧都重新渲染一张文字图，因为数字在变。

title.en: Title, Play, Pause and Game Over Screens
title.zh: 标题、游戏、暂停、结束四个界面

blurb.en: A game is always on exactly one screen. Keep that screen in one variable, change it by looking up (screen, event) in a table, and let the main loop draw whatever the current screen needs.
blurb.zh: 游戏任何时候都恰好在一个界面上。用一个变量记住当前界面，按 (界面, 事件) 查表来切换，主循环按当前界面画该画的东西。

en: What you see: a window 480 by 320 that opens on a title screen reading Press Enter to start. Press Enter and a red-orange ball starts rolling from the left across the middle at 160 pixels a second, with P to pause at the top. Press P and the ball freezes under Paused - P to go on; press P again and it rolls on. When the ball rolls off the right edge, three seconds after it started, the game is over: the ball disappears and the screen reads Game over - Enter. Enter takes you back to the title screen.

The whole flow lives in the TRANSITIONS table: each key is a (state, event) pair and each value is the state it leads to. next_state looks the pair up with get, and a pair that is not in the table - Enter while playing, P on the title screen - leaves the state as it was. run_events feeds a list of events through one after another: run_events("title", ["enter", "p", "p", "crash"]) is "over".

Events come from two places. KEYDOWN events for Enter and P are translated through KEY_EVENTS into the names "enter" and "p"; the "crash" event is made by the game itself when the ball passes the right edge. Everything else in main asks what the state is: the ball only moves while playing, is drawn while playing or paused, and the message comes from MESSAGES.

The same flow could be an if / elif chain with one branch per transition. The table keeps all the rules in one place, where adding a screen means adding a few lines of data. State machines themselves are covered on the Simulation page; here the point is switching screens.
zh: 看到的样子：一个 480×320 的窗口，打开时是标题界面，写着 Press Enter to start。按回车，一个橙红色的球从左边沿中线以每秒 160 像素滚出来，顶上写着 P to pause。按 P，球停住，上面写着 Paused - P to go on；再按 P，球接着滚。球从右边滚出窗口——开始之后三秒——游戏结束：球消失，屏幕上写着 Game over - Enter。按回车回到标题界面。
整个流程都写在 TRANSITIONS 表里：每个键是一对 (状态, 事件)，每个值是它通向的状态。next_state 用 get 查这一对；表里没有的组合——游戏中按回车、标题界面按 P——状态保持不变。run_events 把一串事件一个接一个喂进去：run_events("title", ["enter", "p", "p", "crash"]) 是 "over"。
事件有两个来源。回车和 P 的 KEYDOWN 事件经 KEY_EVENTS 翻译成名字 "enter" 和 "p"；"crash" 事件则是游戏自己在球越过右边缘时造出来的。main 里其余的一切都先问当前状态：球只在游戏中移动，在游戏中和暂停时才画出来，提示文字从 MESSAGES 里取。
同样的流程也可以写成 if / elif 链，一条转移一个分支。查表把所有规则放在一处，加一个界面只是加几行数据。状态机本身见「模拟」一页；这里讲的是界面切换。

lineNotes.en: Translates key codes into the event names the table understands.
lineNotes.zh: 把键码翻译成转移表认识的事件名。

lineNotes.en: An event made by the game itself, not by a key.
lineNotes.zh: 这个事件是游戏自己造的，不是按键来的。
